title: AddaDiscord
description: A smart community integration plugin that opens a configurable GUI with clickable buttons for Discord, YouTube, and other links.
body:
## ✨ AddaDiscord – Smart Community Integration Plugin

AddaDiscord is a lightweight and fully configurable Minecraft plugin designed to seamlessly connect your server with your community platforms.

It provides a modern GUI-based experience where players can instantly access your Discord, YouTube, website, store, and more — directly from within the game.

---

## 🔥 Features

✔ First Join GUI  
Players automatically see your community menu when joining for the first time.

✔ Clickable Buttons / Items  
Each item in the GUI can open external links like:

• Discord  
• YouTube  
• Website  
• Store  
• Voting Page  
• Rules  
• Any Custom URL

✔ Fully Configurable  
Customize everything via config:

• GUI Title  
• GUI Size  
• Items / Buttons  
• Names & Lore  
• Links  
• Messages  
• Prefix

✔ Manual GUI Command  

`/adda dc`

✔ Prefix Customization  

✔ Lightweight & Optimized  

✔ Works with Register/Login Plugins  

---

## ⚙ Example Use Cases

• Promote Discord Server  
• Grow YouTube Channel  
• Show Server Store  
• Improve Player Onboarding  
• Clean Community Hub Menu

---

## 🛠 Commands

/adda dc → Opens Community GUI

---

## 🔐 Permissions

addadiscord.open → Allows GUI access

---

## ✅ Compatibility

✔ Paper  
✔ Spigot  
✔ Optimized Performance  

---

## 💡 Why AddaDiscord?

Instead of spamming chat with links, AddaDiscord provides a clean, modern, and professional GUI interface that players actually enjoy interacting with.

Perfect for SMPs, Networks, and Community Servers.
